results.title: Netweb FY26 Revenue Jumps 90%, Profit 81%; Debt & Inventory Surge - Whalesbook
results.content: # Netweb FY26 Revenue Jumps 90%, Profit 81%; Debt & Inventory Surge. Netweb Technologies India Ltd posted strong FY26 results, with revenue climbing 90% to ₹2,202.41 crore and net profit rising 81% to ₹205.82 crore. However, rapid expansion led to a sharp rise in borrowings (₹270.71 crore) and inventories (₹804.84 crore), sparking concerns over working capital management. The company's performance extended to the fourth quarter (Q4 FY26), with revenue growing 87.93% year-on-year to ₹783.94 crore. Netweb's strong results reflect high demand for its High-Performance Computing (HPC) solutions and electronics manufacturing services (EMS). Netweb's FY26 revenue growth of 90.12% outpaces many listed peers in the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) sector, including companies like Dixon Technologies and Kaynes Technology, which are also experiencing high growth and requiring similar capital infusions. However, the scale of Netweb's debt and inventory increase in FY26 appears more pronounced relative to its previous financial structure when compared to these competitors.

results.content: Home / Markets / Capital Market News / Greaves Finance reports standalone net profit of Rs 0.16 crore in the March 2026 quarter. # Greaves Finance reports standalone net profit of Rs 0.16 crore in the March 2026 quarter. Net profit of Greaves Finance reported to Rs 0.16 crore in the quarter ended March 2026 as against net loss of Rs 0.09 crore during the previous quarter ended March 2025. Sales rose 186.68% to Rs 14.85 crore in the quarter ended March 2026 as against Rs 5.18 crore during the previous quarter ended March 2025. For the full year,net profit reported to Rs 1.57 crore in the year ended March 2026 as against net loss of Rs 7.99 crore during the previous year ended March 2025.
